name: Fudge DESIGN.md
summary: DESIGN.md guides for real websites, generated from references captured in Fudge, to steer coding agents' visual direction.
description: A growing collection of DESIGN.md guides, one per real website domain, built from pages saved in Fudge. Each guide summarizes the site's visual direction, typography, colors and layout, shows the representative captured pages it was based on, separates captured details from interpretation, and links to the Fudge conversation that produced it. Guides are added only when a substantial domain guide is accepted, and a status file tracks migration state.
